visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler with pigtails in a yellow shirt and grey bib sits in a portable high chair on a wooden floor, holding a snack. A grey and white cat approaches her tray from the left in a bright indoor living room. (2) Close-up on the girl as she takes a large bite of a beige biscuit stick. Her eyes are wide as she chews, and her hands are holding the snack near her mouth while she sits in the chair. (3) Split screen view. The top shows the girl eating happily; the bottom shows the cat standing on the floor, looking up towards the food on the high chair tray with curiosity and interest. (4) The girl suddenly lets out a loud shout and points towards the cat with her right hand. The cat, startled by the noise, quickly runs away. The girl continues to hold her snack and watch the cat leave. (5) A medium-sized brown and black dog is seen through a screen window, looking inside at the scene. The girl in the room begins drinking from a pink baby bottle with both hands, ignoring the dog outside the window. (6) Two toddlers are now visible, both sitting in high chairs. The girl on the right in a green chair holds her pink bottle up towards the camera. The girl on the left in the tan chair drinks from a green bottle. (7) The girl in the tan chair tries to clink her bottle with the other girl's but fumbles, laughing as she does so. She then continues eating a small white bun, holding it up for the camera to see. (8) The girl finishes her snack and signals that she is done eating by looking at the camera. The scene fades to a pink end screen featuring a cartoon illustration of a girl and the text POPO'S DAILY LIFE.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful, mid-tempo acoustic BGM with a steady beat begins. An adult male narrator speaks in a warm, casual tone about the kitchen's air conditioning. The audio is clean with minor indoor room tone. (2) Clear crunching sounds occur as a child takes a bite of a snack. The BGM maintains its upbeat energy in the background while the narrator continues his friendly commentary in the mix. (3) The child lets out a high-pitched yum sound. The male narrator responds with a gentle, humorous chuckle and more conversational speech, maintaining a positive and relaxed atmosphere throughout the interaction. (4) A sharp, loud vocal burst from the child as she suddenly shouts. This transient peak is followed by the male narrator laughing loudly and commenting on the volume of the child's voice. (5) Background chatter continues with the child squealing in protest. The sound of a plastic bottle being handled creates low-level rustling and clicking noises, layered over the steady acoustic background music track. (6) Sounds of two children interacting. A distinct plastic clink occurs as they attempt to toast their bottles together. The male narrator continues to guide the interaction with an animated and friendly voice. (7) The child makes soft chewing and swallowing sounds while eating a bun. The upbeat BGM remains consistent until the end of the clip, eventually fading out alongside the final conversational banter and laughter.
